title: The Forbidden City Isn't Really 9,999 Rooms · 故宫 | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone says the Forbidden City has 9,999 rooms. The real number is about 8,700.

China's imperial palace holds 980 buildings and roughly 8,700 rooms, and it was the political heart of the empire for nearly 500 years. It also sits dead-center of Beijing's 7.8-km Central Axis — a perfectly straight north-south line running from the Bell & Drum Towers to Yongdingmen Gate and threading 15 landmarks. That axis was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in July 2024, Beijing's eighth. This is stop 3 on our walk down the line.

🧭 Expert Tip: Enter at the Meridian Gate in the south and exit north through the Gate of Divine Prowess — that way you walk the palace along the axis in one direction, no backtracking.

都说故宫有9999间房，其实只有约8700间。
